rationale.zh: 离子内部态与运动耦合实现可控量子逻辑操作。
rationale.en: Coupling internal and motional states enabled controlled quantum logic.

dateNote.zh: 实验门与Cirac–Zoller同年方案相互关联；不是通用量子计算机已完成。
dateNote.en: The experiment accompanied the Cirac–Zoller proposal; it did not constitute a completed universal computer.

rationale.zh: 提出引力与低维量子场论对偶，为强耦合与量子引力提供工具。
rationale.en: A gravity–field-theory duality supplied tools for strong coupling and quantum gravity.

sources.title: Witten: Anti De Sitter Space And Holography (1998)

dateNote.zh: 1997年预印本，1998年期刊发表；对应关系有大量检验，但并非普遍数学证明或自然界实验确认。
dateNote.en: Preprint in 1997, journal publication in 1998; extensively tested as a conjectured duality, not universally proved or experimentally established in nature.

title.zh: 光子量子隐形传态实验

rationale.zh: 以纠缠光子验证量子态转移协议。
rationale.en: Entangled photons experimentally demonstrated quantum-state transfer.

dateNote.zh: 按所引论文首次公开年。
dateNote.en: Dated by first public publication of the cited work.

rationale.zh: Ia型超新星距离关系显示晚期宇宙膨胀加速。
rationale.en: Type-Ia supernova distances revealed accelerated late-time cosmic expansion.

sources.title: Perlmutter et al.: Measurements of Omega and Lambda from 42 High-Redshift Supernovae (1999)

dateNote.zh: 1998年两组公开关键结果；Perlmutter组主要期刊论文发表于1999年。
dateNote.en: Both teams reported key results in 1998; the main Perlmutter-team journal paper appeared in 1999.

rationale.zh: 大气和太阳中微子的味变化证明中微子具有非零质量差。
rationale.en: Atmospheric and solar flavour changes established nonzero neutrino mass differences.

sources.title: SNO: Direct Evidence for Neutrino Flavor Transformation from Neutral-Current Interactions (2002)

dateNote.zh: 1998年大气振荡证据与2001—2002年太阳味转变证据合并为一个基础发现。
dateNote.en: Combines atmospheric evidence in 1998 with solar flavour transformation in 2001–2002 as one foundational discovery.

title.en: Slow light in an ultracold gas

rationale.zh: 相干透明介质显著降低光脉冲群速度，推进光物质控制。
rationale.en: Coherent transparency slowed optical group velocity and advanced light–matter control.

sources.title: Slow light in an ultracold gas

dateNote.zh: 测量的是介质中的群速度；真空光速并未改变。
dateNote.en: The result concerns group velocity in a medium; vacuum light speed is unchanged.

title.en: Direct observation of the tau neutrino

rationale.zh: DONUT直接辨识τ中微子相互作用，补齐三味中微子。
rationale.en: DONUT directly identified tau-neutrino interactions, completing the three-flavour set.

sources.title: Direct observation of the tau neutrino

dateNote.zh: 2000年宣布，论文发表于2001年。
dateNote.en: Announced in 2000; the paper was published in 2001.

rationale.zh: 阿秒脉冲列与孤立脉冲使电子运动的时间分辨测量成为可能。
rationale.en: Pulse trains and isolated pulses enabled time-resolved studies of electronic motion.

dateNote.zh: 2001年脉冲列与孤立脉冲两项独立实现合并；此前高次谐波研究为其基础。
dateNote.en: Independent pulse-train and isolated-pulse demonstrations in 2001 are combined; earlier high-harmonic work underpinned them.

title.en: A quantum phase transition in an optical lattice

rationale.zh: 可调原子体系实现超流体到Mott绝缘体转变，推进量子模拟。
rationale.en: Tunable atoms realized a superfluid–Mott transition and advanced quantum simulation.

sources.title: A quantum phase transition in an optical lattice

dateNote.zh: 按所引论文首次公开年。
dateNote.en: Dated by first public publication of the cited work.

rationale.zh: 在可调相互作用的费米气体中连接分子凝聚与配对超流。
rationale.en: Tunable Fermi gases connected molecular condensation with paired superfluidity.

dateNote.zh: 采用2004年配对凝聚论文；2003年分子产生与分子BEC是相关前序成果。
dateNote.en: Dated to the 2004 pair-condensation paper; molecule creation and molecular BEC in 2003 were precursors.

title.en: Electrical devices from atomically thin graphene

rationale.zh: 稳定二维碳材料及其电场效应开辟二维电子体系研究。
rationale.en: Stable atomically thin carbon and its field effect opened two-dimensional electronic-material research.

sources.title: Electrical devices from atomically thin graphene
Novoselov et al.: Two-dimensional gas of massless Dirac fermions in graphene (2005)

dateNote.zh: 按所引论文首次公开年。
dateNote.en: Dated by first public publication of the cited work.

title.zh: 数值模拟完整双黑洞合并
title.en: Numerical evolution of a binary black-hole merger

rationale.zh: 稳定演化穿过合并与铃宕，建立引力波波形计算路线。
rationale.en: Stable merger and ringdown evolution opened reliable gravitational-wave waveform calculations.

sources.title: Numerical evolution of a binary black-hole merger

dateNote.zh: 2005年首次成功演化；2005—2006年其他团队的移动穿刺方法进一步推进。
dateNote.en: Dated to the first successful evolution in 2005; moving-puncture methods followed in 2005–2006.

title.zh: 强耦合夸克–胶子等离子体

rationale.zh: RHIC重离子结果显示热QCD物质可呈近理想液体行为。
rationale.en: RHIC results showed hot QCD matter behaving as a nearly ideal liquid.

dateNote.zh: 2005年四合作组评述确认新物质及强耦合特征；并非把此前所有重离子证据抹去。
dateNote.en: Dated to the four RHIC assessments in 2005, following earlier heavy-ion evidence.

rationale.zh: HgTe量子阱实现零外磁场下具有边缘导电态的拓扑相。
rationale.en: HgTe quantum wells realized a topological phase with conducting edges at zero magnetic field.

dateNote.zh: 采用2007年实验验证；相关理论发表于2005—2006年。
dateNote.en: Dated to experimental verification in 2007, following theory in 2005–2006.

rationale.zh: 两实验发现与希格斯机制预期相符的新玻色子，完成标准模型关键检验。
rationale.en: Two experiments found the boson associated with the Higgs mechanism, completing a central Standard Model test.

sources.title: CMS: Observation of a New Boson at a Mass of 125 GeV (2012)
ATLAS: Observation of a new particle in the search for the Standard Model Higgs boson (2012)

dateNote.zh: 首次公开为2012年7月4日；两合作组共同成果，仅计一次，个人关联不代表全部作者。
dateNote.en: First announced on 4 July 2012; the two collaborations are counted once, and linked individuals do not represent all authors.

title.zh: 高能天体中微子的发现

rationale.zh: IceCube建立地外高能中微子通量，开辟高能中微子天文学。
rationale.en: IceCube established an extraterrestrial high-energy flux, opening high-energy neutrino astronomy.

dateNote.zh: 按2013年论文；数据取自2010—2012年，不采用后来的获奖年。
dateNote.en: Dated to the 2013 paper using 2010–2012 data, not a later award.

title.zh: 同时关闭主要漏洞的贝尔检验

rationale.zh: 实验同时处理局域性与探测漏洞，强化量子非局域关联证据。
rationale.en: Tests addressed locality and detection loopholes together, strengthening quantum-correlation evidence.

dateNote.zh: 2015年多组独立实验合并计一次；“无漏洞”指特定主要实验漏洞。
dateNote.en: Independent 2015 demonstrations are counted once; “loophole-free” concerns specified major experimental loopholes.

rationale.zh: 晶体中的Weyl准粒子与费米弧连接拓扑能带和输运。
rationale.en: Weyl quasiparticles and Fermi arcs connected topological bands with transport.

dateNote.zh: 此处为凝聚态准粒子，不是发现新的基本Weyl粒子。
dateNote.en: These are condensed-matter quasiparticles, not newly discovered fundamental Weyl particles.

title.zh: 引力波的首次直接探测
title.en: The first direct detection of gravitational waves

rationale.zh: 双黑洞信号直接验证动态时空辐射，开启引力波天文学。
rationale.en: A binary-black-hole signal established dynamical spacetime radiation and gravitational-wave astronomy.

sources.title: The first direct detection of gravitational waves
LIGO: Gravitational Waves Detected 100 Years After Einstein’s Prediction

dateNote.zh: 信号于2015年9月14日检测；首次公开与论文为2016年2月11日，轴采用2016年。
dateNote.en: Detected on 14 September 2015; first announcement and publication were on 11 February 2016, which sets the event year.

title.zh: 双中子星合并的多信使观测
title.en: Multi-messenger observations of a neutron-star merger

rationale.zh: 引力波、γ射线和千新星关联检验中子星合并及重元素起源。
rationale.en: Gravitational waves, gamma rays, and a kilonova tested merger physics and heavy-element origins.

sources.title: Multi-messenger observations of a neutron-star merger

dateNote.zh: 2017年8月17日观测，10月16日联合公开。
dateNote.en: Observed on 17 August 2017 and jointly announced on 16 October.

title.zh: 魔角扭转石墨烯的超导

rationale.zh: 可调莫尔能带产生关联绝缘与超导，开辟扭转电子学。
rationale.en: Tunable moiré bands produced correlated insulation and superconductivity, opening twistronics.

dateNote.zh: 按所引论文首次公开年。
dateNote.en: Dated by first public publication of the cited work.

rationale.zh: 地球尺度毫米波干涉测量解析黑洞附近的亮环与阴影。
rationale.en: Earth-scale millimetre interferometry resolved a bright ring and shadow near a black hole.

sources.title: ESO: First Image of a Black Hole (10 April 2019)

dateNote.zh: 数据采于2017年；首次公开图像为2019年4月10日，轴采用2019年。
dateNote.en: Data were collected in 2017; the first public image was released on 10 April 2019.

title.zh: 太阳CNO循环中微子的探测

rationale.zh: 直接测得CNO燃烧链的中微子证据，检验恒星核反应。
rationale.en: Neutrino evidence for CNO burning directly tested stellar nuclear reactions.

dateNote.zh: 按所引论文首次公开年。
dateNote.en: Dated by first public publication of the cited work.

title.zh: 惯性约束聚变靶增益超过一

rationale.zh: NIF靶丸聚变能量首次超过入射激光能，验证燃烧等离子体路线。
rationale.en: NIF fusion output first exceeded incident laser energy, advancing burning-plasma experiments.

dateNote.zh: 2022年12月5日实验，12月13日宣布；仅为靶丸层面的能量增益，不是整设施净发电。
dateNote.en: Experiment on 5 December 2022, announced on 13 December; this is target gain, not facility-wide net electricity.

title.zh: 纳赫兹引力波背景的证据
title.en: Evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background

rationale.zh: 脉冲星到达时刻的相关结构开启纳赫兹引力波观测窗口。
rationale.en: Correlated pulsar timing opened the nanohertz gravitational-wave observational window.

sources.title: Evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background

dateNote.zh: 2023年多组报告统计证据；背景天体来源和谱细节仍在检验，重要性暂定。
dateNote.en: Several arrays reported statistical evidence in 2023; source populations and spectral details remain under study, so importance is provisional.

title.zh: 低于阈值的表面码量子纠错

rationale.zh: 扩大逻辑存储码可降低错误率，为可扩展容错计算提供实验依据。
rationale.en: Larger logical memory codes reduced errors, supporting scalable fault-tolerant computation.

dateNote.zh: 2024年12月9日在线发表、2025年卷期；2026年更正图3a的重复码横轴及图例标签。此项记录逻辑存储实验，长期影响暂定。
dateNote.en: Online publication on 9 December 2024, in a 2025 issue; a 2026 correction fixed repetition-code axis and legend labels in Fig. 3a. This records a logical-memory experiment; long-term impact remains provisional.

rationale.zh: Λb衰变首次达到重子CP破坏的观测标准，扩展味物理检验。
rationale.en: Lambda-b decays established baryonic CP violation and extended flavour-physics tests.

dateNote.zh: 2025年3月公开，7月发表；是CP破坏的新体系观测，非标准模型之外的证明，重要性暂定。
dateNote.en: Announced in March 2025 and published in July; this extends CP tests to baryons and does not establish physics beyond the Standard Model.
